01 / Profile

Professional Snapshot

I'm an MBA Business Analytics candidate at Lovely Professional University, building on a BBA foundation from DAV University, Jalandhar. My focus is turning raw business data into decisions people can actually act on — across three internships I've cleaned datasets, built Power BI dashboards, and translated numbers into recommendations stakeholders could use immediately. I've also built and sold a brand from scratch, so I care as much about the "so what" of an insight as the analysis behind it. I work across Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI.

05 / Case Studies

Projects

Live projects broken into the same process a working analyst follows — problem, objective, method, and result.

Case 01
BrandSell — Launching Zariya, a Punjabi Jutti Brand
Brand StrategyDigital MarketingRevenue Generation
Business Problem
A set of unbranded Punjabi jutti products had no market identity, no established customer base, and no structured sales channel.
Objective
Build a complete brand — Zariya — from the ground up and generate measurable revenue within a one-month campaign window as part of a live selling project at LPU.
Method
Converted unbranded stock into a branded product line, developed a brand identity and online presence, and ran digital promotion to acquire customers directly.
Tools
Brand Positioning · Digital Promotion · Customer Acquisition · Online Selling
Brand Identity→Online Presence→Customer Acquisition→Sales
Result
Generated ₹42,000 in revenue within the first month, through direct customer acquisition, digital promotion and strategic product selling.
Case 02
Financial Ratio Analysis — Agni Green Ltd. vs TATA Power Solar Ltd.
Financial AnalysisRatio AnalysisReporting
Business Problem
Comparing the financial health of two renewable-energy companies required more than headline numbers — it needed a structured, ratio-based view of liquidity, profitability, leverage and efficiency.
Objective
Assess the comparative financial performance, strengths and weaknesses of Agni Green Ltd. and TATA Power Solar Ltd. to understand their relative industry positioning.
Method
Performed a comprehensive financial statement analysis and computed liquidity, profitability, leverage and efficiency ratios for both companies from their published financials.
Tools
Financial Statement Analysis · Ratio Analysis · MS Excel
Collect Statements→Compute Ratios→Compare→Report
Result
Delivered a structured analytical report with supporting charts, highlighting each company's comparative strengths, weaknesses and industry positioning.
